headerDisplay: Generac for Homebridge shows the standby generators on your Mobile Link account in the Home app. Each generator appears as a Running sensor, a Fault sensor, a Maintenance Due sensor and a starting battery reading. Propane models will also get a tank level later.

pollIdleMinutes.title: Poll interval while idle (minutes)
pollIdleMinutes.description: Mobile Link updates every few minutes and limits how often you can check. Faster than this rarely helps.

pollActiveSeconds.title: Poll interval while running or in fault (seconds)
pollActiveSeconds.description: Used while a generator is running, exercising, or reporting a problem.

batteryLowVoltage.title: Low battery threshold (volts)
batteryLowVoltage.description: A healthy starting battery on charge reads 13.4 to 13.8 V.

faultOnStopped.title: Treat Stopped as a fault
faultOnStopped.description: Stopped means the control switch is in OFF and the generator won't start during an outage.

faultOnDisconnected.title: Treat a lost connection as a fault
faultOnDisconnected.description: Off by default. Wi-Fi drops are common and the sensors already show Not responding.

attentionSensor.title: Attention needed sensor
attentionSensor.description: Adds an occupancy sensor to HomeKit that turns on when the plugin needs you to reconnect.

exerciseSensor.title: Exercising sensor
exerciseSensor.description: Adds a sensor that opens while the weekly exercise runs, or when Mobile Link reports one finished. Use it to confirm the generator exercised this week.

exerciseTime.title: Exercise time
exerciseTime.description: When your generator's weekly exercise starts. Prefilled from Mobile Link; correct it if your unit starts at a different time. The plugin checks more often around this time every day.

exerciseHoldMinutes.title: Exercise hold (minutes)
exerciseHoldMinutes.description: How long the Exercising sensor stays open after an exercise is detected.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Verbose logging. Your password is never logged, even with this on.

validationMessages.pattern: Enter a time as HH:MM, for example 10:00.
